/* Formatted on 9/21/2026 4:00:28 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
SELECT /* ============================================================
          REQUEST
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX (r.REQUEST_ID)         AS REQUEST_ID,
       r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       r.CONTRACT_PDF_REF,
       r.BANK_SHEET_REF,
       r.RECEIVED_AT,
       r.REQUEST_DATE,
       r.PREVIOUS_REQUEST_DATE,
       /* ============================================================
          STATUS
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX (r.STATUS_ID)          AS STATUS_ID,
       st.STATUS_CODE                  STATUS,
       r.CURRENT_STAGE,
       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST TYPE
          ============================================================ */
       r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
       rt.REQUEST_TYPE_CODE,
       rt.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,
       /* ============================================================
          MAKER
          ============================================================ */
       r.MAKER_ID,
       r.MAKER_ACTION,
       r.MAKER_AT,
       /* ============================================================
          FRAUD
          ============================================================ */
       r.FRAUD_ID,
       r.FRAUD_ACTION,
       r.FRAUD_AT,
       /* ============================================================
          CHECKER
          ============================================================ */
       r.CHECKER_ID,
       r.CHECKER_ACTION,
       r.CHECKER_AT,
       /* ============================================================
          REJECTION / PUSHBACK
          ============================================================ */
       r.REJECT_REASON_CODE,
       r.REJECT_REASON_DESC,
       r.BANK_PUSHBACK_NOTE,
       /* ============================================================
          AUDIT
          ============================================================ */
       r.CREATED_AT,
       r.UPDATED_AT,
       r.CREATED_BY,
       r.UPDATED_BY,
       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST COMMENT
          ============================================================ */
       r.REQUEST_COMMENT,
       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST-LEVEL ASSIGNMENTS
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX (r.RM_ID)              AS RM_ID,
       rm.RM_NAME                      AS RM_NAME,
       rm.RM_ORACLE_CODE               AS RM_ORACLE_CODE,
       RAWTOHEX (r.TEAM_LEADER_ID)     AS TEAM_LEADER_ID,
       tl.RM_NAME                      AS TEAM_LEADER_NAME,
       tl.RM_ORACLE_CODE               AS TEAM_LEADER_ORACLE_CODE,
       RAWTOHEX (r.RMS_ORACLE_ID)      AS RMS_ORACLE_ID,
       rms.RM_NAME                     AS RMS_ORACLE_NAME,
       rms.RM_ORACLE_CODE              AS RMS_ORACLE_CODE,
       /* ============================================================
          MERCHANT
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX (r.MERCHANT_ID)        AS MERCHANT_ID,
       m.CIF,
       m.NATIONAL_ID,
       m.OWNER_NAME_AR,
       m.COMPANY_NAME,
       m.COMPANY_NAME_AR,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
       m.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
       m.MOBILE_PRIMARY,
       m.ADDRESS_EN,
       m.ADDRESS_AR,
       m.CITY,
       m.REGION,
       m.BRANCH_CODE,
       m.BANK_ACCOUNT
  FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST  r
       JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
           ON m.MERCHANT_ID = r.MERCHANT_ID AND m.IS_DELETED = 0
       LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_TYPE rt
           ON rt.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID
       LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS rm ON rm.RM_ID = r.RM_ID
       LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS tl ON tl.RM_ID = r.TEAM_LEADER_ID
       LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS rms ON rms.RM_ID = r.RMS_ORACLE_ID
       LEFT JOIN MMS_REQUEST_STATUS st ON st.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID
 WHERE     r.REQUEST_ID =
           HEXTORAW (
               REPLACE ('{{ JS_ADD_TERMINAL.getRequestId() }}', '-', ''))
       AND r.IS_DELETED = 0
